`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient`

That module defines the memo React Query hooks (`useMemos`, `useInfiniteMemos`, `useMemo`, `useCreateMemo`, `useUpdateMemo`, `useDeleteMemo`, etc.) and calls the generated Connect client imported from `@/connect`:

```5:5:web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts

```

`memoServiceClient` is created from the generated `MemoService` protobuf client in `web/src/connect.ts`:

```197:197:web/src/connect.ts
export const memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport);
```
